sentences.text:
For the Petitioners : Mr. Vikash Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Subodh Kr. Dubey, Addl.P.P.
For the OP 2 : Mr. Manjeet Kumar, Advocate ------
Order No:-05 Dated:-09-07-2025 I.A. No.6455 of 2025 Heard the parties.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this interlocutory application has been filed with a prayer to amend the Cr.M.P. No. 4094 of 2023 by making additional prayer for quashing the order dated 11.09.2024 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Seraikella, whereby the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Seraikella has found prima facie case, for proceeding under Section 406/420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
It is next submitted that the proposed amendment was necessitated because of the developments which took place after filing of this criminal miscellaneous petition.
It is lastly submitted that unless the proposed amendment is allowed, the petitioners will be highly prejudiced.

Considering the aforesaid facts, the prayer for amendment made in this interlocutory application is allowed and the petitioners are directed to file a consolidated criminal miscellaneous petition incorporating the amendment as proposed in para-7 of this interlocutory application; which is allowed by this order; within two weeks, failing which, this criminal miscellaneous petition shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Bench.
This interlocutory application is disposed of accordingly.
